title: 전직대통령 예우에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:03378:19810302:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Act No. 3378, March 2, 1981>

(1) (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) (Transitional Measures) For three months after this Act enters into force, remuneration for the former secretaries of former Presidents employed pursuant to former Article 5 as at the time this Act enters into force shall continue to be borne by the National Treasury under the former provisions: Provided, That, if a secretary is appointed under this Act before the expiration of that period, the National Treasury shall cease to bear the remuneration of a former secretary corresponding to the rank of the newly appointed secretary.
